Introduction
“ The world is a book and those who do not travel read only one page ”
If you want to enjoy the beauty of Darjeeling; ‘The Queen of Hills’ or want to bask in the glory of ‘The City of Joy’; Kolkata then you must come and feel the vibes at Bubble Beds. As a reputed brand,Bubble Beds offers budget accommodation and distinct local experience at Darjeeling and Kolkata located in Eastern part of India. Being a popular backpacker’s hostel, we offer stay like the home away where you can enjoy great comfort within your budget, meet fellow travellers from across the world and share your travel stories, make friends over a cup of Coffee, soak in the fun of board games together with friends or pick up a book of your choice from the shelf. Loaded with lots of facilities & services, we ensure you are tuned at your best at Bubble Beds. Cooking classes & yoga sessions will surely keep your senses afresh. Our city tours and packages of Darjeeling & Kolkata are the best and maximise your local experience. If you are a solo traveller, backpacker, group of friends or a family looking for backpackers hostel or homestay in Darjeeling or Kolkata, come and stay with us at Bubble Beds, spend wonderful moments and create lasting memories.

Friendly staff who will help you with traveling around the Kolkata area. Also, they can order dinner for you in the evenings. Nice common area to meet the other travelers.
- Ben Schroeder
Excellent hostel!! Very clean with a great atmosphere and the staff are very friendly and helpful. The food is delicious too.
- mark horkan
I had a great time at Bubble Beds, the staff is welcoming and the location just right to get around Kolkata. It was a lovely stay.
- James Rehman
Its a nice hostel. The staff is very helpful and knows the city very well. The hostel is clean and has a lot of facilities like books to read, aqua guard, refrigerator, carrom and chess. They offer tea/coffee for free once in a day. There is a paid washing machine and tea/coffee machine, but its cheap. The place is very well connected. I would recommend.
- Aditya Shah
It's a nice place to stay, away from the city bustle and yet well connected. It's just 30 minutes by metro to the city. The rooms and toilets are maintained well and cleaned everyday. The best part is that you get to meet people, mostly from other countries, learn new culture and things. I really had a good experience staying for 5 days there. I hope you will too!
- Rohit Nandakumar

Cancellation Policy
[Cancellation Charge is calculated as percentage of total booking amount]
Cancellation charge is:
Nil if cancelled 15 days before check-in date.
50% if cancelled within 15-5 days before check-in date.
100% if cancelled within 5 days before check-in date.
N.B Any payment or advance amount taken by the hostel for the booking will be retained as per cancellation policy.
For Group booking of 4 or more guests, Cancellation charge is:
Nil if cancelled 30 days before check-in date.
50% if cancelled within 30- 15 days before check-in date.
100% if cancelled within 15 days before check-in date.
N.B. Any payment or advance amount taken by the hostel for the booking will be retained as per cancellation policy.
N.B. Any refund will be credited to the original payment source within 5-7 working days.
Hotel Policy:
Prices are exclusive of taxes. (12% GST will be added on bed and room prices)
Standard Check-in time: 1 pm onward (afternoon) & Check-out time: before 11 am(*However, guest can check-in & check-out any time he wishes depending on his schedule and charge will be calculated based on that)
Breakfast is available from 8:00 am to 10:30 am
Guest cannot keep his/her luggage in the room after check-out time. If needed, he/she can keep the luggage at the reception for few hours after check-out
Guest must provide valid Govt. approved Identity Proof, i.e. Passport, Aadhar card, Voter ID, Driving Licence (Not PAN) at the time of Check-in.
Guest has to pay the full amount of the booking at the time of Check-in. (Cash, Instant bank transfer, UPI, Card payment is accepted).
No payment will be refunded by the hostel under any circumstances after booking is confirmed and payment is collected (Only as per Cancellation policy).
Guest must compensate in case of any property belonging is damaged by him/her.
In case guest brings friends (maximum 2 allowed, timing: from 9am to 7pm) from outside (who are not staying in the hostel), then the friends must submit their valid original ID proof at the reception during entry and can collect the same during exit. Guest's friends are allowed only in the lounge/common area; not in the rooms.
Minors (blow 18 yrs of age) are not allowed in the dormitories.
Pets are not allowed.
Not accessible by wheel chair, No elevator/lift.
Hostel management cannot provide any back up power service (or limited power back up) in case of power cut (extremely rare though).
Bicycle and Motor Cycle parking is allowed.
Local residents (i.e. residents of the same cily) are not allowed to book or else Hostel will have the right to cancel/deny the booking.
The Hostel Management can ask the guest for advance amount after a booking is confirmed by paying cash at the reception/UPI or Debit or Credit card/ online bank transfer (NEFT or IMPS) / deposit in the bank account provided or by any other suitable way.
Group booking (more than 3 persons) must be done directly through the hostel. Hostel does not accept group booking (more than 3 persons) through any third party booking websites; and holds the right to deny such bookings.
In case of booking for group bigger than 3 persons, the ID card of at least 1 guest has to be deposited at the reception. It'll be returned only at the time of check-out.
No smoking, No Alcohol, No Food, No loud talk is allowed inside the dormitory rooms. Smoking is only allowed in designated smoking areas and in the open areas.
In-House Restaurant is available. Meals (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner) can be ordered at the reception.
We have great tour service in and around Darjeeling. It can be booked at the reception.
Hotel Check in Time: 01:00 PM
Hotel Check out Time: 11:00 AM
N.B Right of admission is reserved by the hostel.
